blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224772 (2026-10-19), the sole catalogued deployment is the Ethereum upgradeable proxy 0xe1753f2e00940cc31213dd92013cf019dfe4ca1d (100% of supply; material). The EIP-1967 implementation is Sourcify-verified sGho 0xff229a0bbb614a284de8ae0e41e5974878fd7c04 and the ProxyAdmin is 0xc15700631020eba02317964550365b95a9a28adb. The verified implementation exposes no blacklist, denylist, freeze, seizure, forced-transfer or arbitrary-holder burn entrypoint; TOKEN_RESCUER_ROLE emergencyTokenTransfer can move only unaccounted tokens held by the contract, not user share balances. Its pause()/unpause() entrypoints are gated by PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE and the ERC-20 _update hook is whenNotPaused, so the guardian can halt all holder transfers, deposits, withdrawals, mints and burns. At block 26224772, hasRole(PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE, 0x5300a1a15135ea4dc7ad5a167152c01efc9b192a)=true and paused()=false. That is a direct system-wide transfer pause (direct Possible under the FreezeWatch decision procedure, docs/blacklist-tracker.md), not a holder-targeted freeze. Parent GHO's 2026-10-19 assessment is Upstream: pinned drawn GSM debt plus issuer-controlled Horizon collateral establishes at least 53.53115652% qualifying debt-weighted exposure, even before Core/Lido collateral contributions; the 100% GHO reserve claim therefore adds inherited issuer/custodian exposure, while sGHO remains direct Possible because its own global pause takes precedence. Any change to the parent does not remove the local pause.

oracleRisk.summary: sGHO share-to-GHO conversion uses a yield index accrued at the target rate set through YIELD_MANAGER_ROLE, rather than a balance-derived ERC-4626 ratio. At Ethereum block 26097120, targetRate() was 450 basis points, set via the sGhoSteward, callable only by the Risk Council Safe. D11 therefore identifies a wrapper-local discretionary price-relevant input. Parent GHO collateral-oracle exposure remains separate; no external feed or liquidation engine is inferred for the wrapper.

branchApplicability.rationale: Aave's dated launch configuration defines sGHO as an ERC-4626 vault whose internal yield index accrues at a governance-configured rate and is reflected in the share-to-GHO conversion rate. That price-sensitive exchange-rate authority is used to value mint, withdrawal, and redemption amounts. sGHO holders do not open borrower positions, so the applicable authority is scored at the top level without collateral-liquidation branch rows; the underlying GHO parent carries its separate Aave reserve-oracle exposure.
